title: Shrink-only baseline
description: The findings a repository check keeps for now, each with why and who owns it. A run that finds a key not listed fails (fresh); a listed key with an empty or missing reason or owner fails (unexplained); a listed key no longer found fails until its entry is removed (paidOff). A key may be listed once; the reference reconciler (reconcile.sh) refuses a duplicate, which this schema cannot see.

check.description: The check whose findings these are.

key.description: The finding's stable key, as the check prints it, with no surrounding spaces.

reason.description: Why the finding is kept. Empty or missing makes the entry unexplained, which fails.

owner.description: Who pays the finding off. Empty or missing makes the entry unexplained, which fails.
